WATCH: Chaos unfolds aboard a pre-Thanksgiving flight to Chicago after a passenger allegedly tries to open an aircraft door midflight.

Crew members and fellow passengers restrain the man before the American Airlines flight lands safely in Phoenix.

The incident comes as the FAA

BREAKING: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade is officially postponed to Saturday, Nov. 28, as a monster storm barrels toward New York City.

This marks the first time the historic parade has ever been moved due to weather. | @WillCainShow https://t.co/U0KFSxacLS
